title: Logo colourways
slide_intent: Choose a logo color in relation to the background it will occupy. The actual pairing determines whether the mark has sufficient visual separation.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can keep black as the familiar default mark while allowing a controlled set of alternatives for photography and colored fields.
demonstration: Columns compare black, white, blue, pink and green logo treatments. The black and white columns show several backgrounds, and the colored logos are presented on black.
practical_value: Use the matrix to select an approved foreground and background pair. Check the special instruction about white on black.

content_islands.name: Guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and explanation of the predominant black mark in the left text column.

content_islands.name: Pairing matrix
content_islands.spec: Label each logo color above a column of specimen tiles. Align matching background treatments by row, including photographs under the black and white variants.

content_islands.name: Restrictions
content_islands.spec: Keep the warning about the white-on-black pairing beside the colored specimens. Place the note applying these pairings to secondary logo and symbol near the left column.
